lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello Mama. I am calling from Dubai. Everything is good. The job... it is very good.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, can you repeat that? The line is not clear... Yes, yes. I am fine. Do not worry.

lines.speaker: Official
lines.text: Mr. Macal? Dune and Company. We need to talk about your contract. Today, please.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Today? Okay. I am on my way. Thank you for calling.
lines.direction: voice drops, breath catches, then forced calm

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُم يا جَمَاعَة فِي يَلَّا فْلُوِنْت! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَالنَّهَارْدَه هَنِيشْ مَعَ مَكَّال فِي دُبَاي...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: مَكَّال بَيِسَجِّلْ ڤُويْس نُوتْ لِأُمُّه، وَبَيِقُولْ إِنْ كُلِّ حَاجَة تَمَام...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبَعْدِينْ، التِّلِيفُونْ بَيِرِنْ! شَرِكَة دُونْ أَنْدْ كَمْبَانِي عَايْزِينْ يِتْكَلِّمُوا مَعَاه، وَالنَّهَارْدَه كَمَان!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خَلِّيكُمْ مَعَايَا، وَسَمْعُوا كُوَيِّس لِتَلَاتَة عِبَارَات: Hello, I am Macal... Can you repeat that, please? ... وَ Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، نِسْمَعْ الْقِصَّة مَعَ بَعْض!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello Mama. I am recording this voice note for you. Dubai is very big. Everything is good. I am okay.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I live here since two weeks, but I already know the streets. Do not worry about me, please.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Send. ... Ya rabbi. I hope she believes that.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Where to, boss?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Good morning. I am Macal. Dune and Company, please. Al... Al Quoz?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Dune and Company? Yes, yes, I know it. You are new here?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, can you repeat that, please? The traffic is loud.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: I said, you are new here? First time in Dubai?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes. First time. I am from Egypt. I work in... I am trying to work in Dubai. It is a big dream.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Good, good. Dream is good. Everyone here started somewhere. We are all the same.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. Nice to meet you, sir.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Nice to meet you too, Macal. We are here. Dune and Company. Good luck, boss.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. ... Okay, Macal. Big smile. Deep breath. You can do this.
lines.direction: whispering to self, anxious, then steeling himself

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب، تَعَالُوا نْشُوفْ مَعَ بَعْضْ تَلَاتَة عِبَارَات حِلْوِينْ مِنْ الْمَشْهَدْ دَه. أَوَّلْ وَاحِدَة: Hello, I am Macal... لَمَّا تِعَرِّفْ نَفْسَكْ، قُولْ اسْمَكْ عَلْطُولْ. زَي: Hello, I am Nour.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي وَاحِدَة: Can you repeat that, please? ... دِي بْتِقُولْهَا لَمَّا مِشْ سَامِعْ كُوَيِّسْ. مِثَال: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَالْتْ وَاحِدَة: Nice to meet you... بْتِقُولْهَا أَوَّلْ مَرَّة تِقَابِلْ حَدْ. وَالرَّدْ: Nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي غَلْطَة مَكَّال: هُوَ قَالْ I live here since two weeks. ... الْمَشْكِلَة إِنْ كَلِمَة since بْتِجِي مَعَ الْوَقْتْ الْمُمْتَدْدْ، زَي since two o'clock. مَعَ مُدَّة زَي two weeks، بْنِقُولْ: I have lived here for two weeks.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا بَقَى عَلَى الْمَعْمَلْ! النَّهَارْدَه بْنِشْتَغَلْ عَلَى word stress... الْكَلِمَة فِيهَا مَقْطَعْ قَوِي، وَهُوَ الْمَقْطَعْ الْمُهِمِّ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خُدْ بَالَكْ مِنْ: repeat. الْغَلَطْ الْمَشْهُورْ: rePEAT... وَالصَّحْ: rePEAT. كَرِّرْ وَرَايَا: rePEAT.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَانِي: company. الْغَلَطْ: comPANy... وَالصَّحْ: COMpany. كَرِّرْ: COMpany. ... قُولْهَا مَرَّة كْمَان!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بْرَافُو عَلِيكُمْ! الْوَرَقَة وَالْقَلَمْ، وَالْمَقْطَعْ الْقَوِي دَايْمًا. لَمَّا تِحْفَظْ الْكَلِمَة الْغَلْطْ، الْمُسْتَمِعْ بِيِتْلَخْبَطْ... فَخَلِّي بَالَكْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا نْرُوحْ لِلْأَحْدَاثْ... الْمَشْهَدْ الْجَايْ!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay... deep breath. It is just a voice note. For Mama. She thinks I am already a big manager.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello, Mama. I am Macal. I am fine here. Dubai is... very big. And I have a job interview this Friday. No, wait. Delete. Again.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello, Mama. I miss you. I am still... I am still trying. But I have an office. And a friend here. Do not worry about me.
lines.direction: soft, honest, a small crack in his voice

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Send. ... Oh no. My finger slipped. It sent before I finished.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: لحظة... ماما بتتصل. ألو؟ ألو ماما؟ آسف يا ماما، الرسالة كانت... ماما، بتسمعيني؟
lines.direction: switches instantly to warm Egyptian Arabic, flustered but tender — his real self

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal? Hey, it is Nour. Sorry, wrong number. But listen. Dune and Company. We need your two-minute video by Friday. For the fellowship. Can you do it?
lines.direction: warm, fast, totally unaware she just caught him mid-panic

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: A video? Two minutes? In English? Nour, I... okay. Okay. I can try. I will try.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Good. And Macal? I have lived here for two weeks too. You are not alone. Bye.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: She said... I have lived here for two weeks. For. Not since. Okay. Okay, Macal. You can do this.
lines.direction: small triumph, repeating the corrected phrase to himself

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: New message. Macal, my friend. I heard about the video. Just a small tip. Do not embarrass us. Good luck.
lines.direction: polished, friendly on the surface, cold underneath

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا جَمَاعَة... نِلَخَّصْ بِسُرْعَة! أَوَّلْ حَاجَة: Can you repeat that, please? ... وَتَانِي حَاجَة: Nice to meet you. ... وَتَالْتْ حَاجَة، وَدِي الْمُهِمَّة: I have lived here for two weeks. ... بِـ for، مِشْ بِـ since، فَخَلِّي بَالَكْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الْحَلْقَة، يَا أَبْطَال... هِيَّ: Nice to meet you. ... رَكِّزْ عَلَى الـ stress: Nice to MEET you. ... كَرِّرْهَا مَعَايَا: Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي التَّحَدِّي... عَايِزْكُمْ تِسَجِّلُوا ڤُويس نُوت صُغَيَّر، فِيهْ عِبَارَة الْحَلْقَة: Nice to meet you. ... قُولْهَا بِصَوْتْكْ، وَبِالـ stress الصَّح، وَابْعَتُوهَا لَنَا عَلَى تِلِيجْرَام... فِي Empire English Community.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: إِحْنَا هِنِسْمَعْ صَوْتْكُمْ، وَنِشَجِّعْكُمْ وَاحِدْ وَاحِدْ... الْمَكَانْ دَه بَيْتُكُمْ، مِشْ وَاجِبْ! ... يَلَّا، سَجِّلُوا، وَابْعَتُوا. ... أَنَا مُسْتَهْدِيكُمْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَلَا تِنْسُوا: الْمَقْطَعْ الْقَوِي، وَالْوَرَقَة وَالْقَلَمْ. ... أَشُوفْكُمْ فِي الْحَلْقَة الْجَايَة... يَلَّا فْلُوَنْتْ!

phonetic_focus.note: Which syllable carries the beat (e.g. reCORD the verb vs. REcord the noun). Getting stress right matters more than any single sound.
